ui.json:/rules/boardDesc: Spend Coins to melt snow-locked tiles. Tap Frost Bubbles to pop them, and open Treasure Chests when their timers end.
ui.json:/rules/storyDesc: Open "Main Quest" on the task shelf or enter the "Valley" to play 6 chapters and 24 story scenes in order. Awaken the Frostheart and bring back spring; your journal will keep the memories you make with the valley's people.
story.json:/prologue/3/1: He used to say—someone always has to clear the first patch of snow. Now it's your turn to carry this wind lantern home.
story.json:/chapters/0/subtitle: The First Fire, the First Wisp of Smoke
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/0/pre/0/1: There may still be a spark alive beneath the fire pit in the plaza!
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/0/pre/1/1: Child, merge a roaring Bonfire, then spend a few Coins to get it going—this is where the village wakes.
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/0/dialogue/: Ten years... I can finally feel my fingers again. I'm Gunnar, the last old hunter who never left this village.
Listen—someone just opened a window. That first fire isn't a pretty sight. It's proof they finally dare to believe we've come back.
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/1/pre/1/1: Merge two sturdy Wood Planks and set aside a little pay, so these old bones can sleep one night without snow falling in.
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/2/pre/1/1: But the bridge is broken, and I'm too scared to trust the ice. Could you lay a Wooden Beam and light a Torch to show the way? Everyone is waiting for news from outside.
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/2/dialogue/: L-the letters can reach the village now! Look at this one—it came from beyond the mountain, addressed to "Those Still in Frostwhisper Valley."
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/3/dialogue/: Before he climbed the mountain, he gave me this wind lantern and said, "When the next person willing to clear the snow comes home, return it to them for me."
story.json:/chapters/1/nodes/0/dialogue/: I promised my sister I'd keep the shop open until she came home for the first pie from my oven.
The first pie is yours, {{playerName}}. Thank you for letting me believe I can wait for someone again.
The first pie is yours. Thank you for letting me believe I can wait for someone again.
story.json:/chapters/1/nodes/1/dialogue/: Every hat should be soft and cozy, with a scarf for each person. No one gets left in the cold.
story.json:/chapters/1/nodes/2/pre/1/1: Fit sturdy Door & Window Frames, then brew plenty of Hot Tea for the icebreakers. Once the ice gives way, this route will live again.
story.json:/chapters/1/nodes/3/dialogue/: Wind lanterns line the eaves. Berry Pies are sliced and shared, Hot Cocoa warms everyone from within, and new hats glow soft and fuzzy in the light.
It's time. Let's climb the mountain and face the flame no one has dared touch in ten years.
story.json:/chapters/2/hook: If rekindling the Sacred Flame isn't the end, what truly froze the valley?
story.json:/chapters/2/nodes/0/pre/1/1: I've reinforced the stone walls. All we need is a Warm Stove and some sturdy Door & Window Frames. Make the hall livable first; we'll build the true Fireplace once everyone returns.
story.json:/chapters/2/nodes/0/dialogue/: Once this Warm Stove is burning, even the stones can breathe easy. When everyone returns, we'll rebuild it into a Fireplace that lasts a hundred years.
story.json:/chapters/2/nodes/2/pre/0/1: A Warm Stove, Honey Brew, a Furniture Set... we don't need the rarest offerings in the world. {{playerName}}, a Flamekeeper brings every bit of warmth within reach.
story.json:/chapters/2/nodes/2/pre/0/2/s: A Warm Stove, Honey Brew, a Furniture Set... we don't need the rarest offerings in the world. A Flamekeeper brings every bit of warmth within reach.
story.json:/chapters/2/nodes/2/dialogue/: The Warm Stove's flame touched the heart of the altar—whoosh! A pillar of gold surged upward, and the Frostwood Furniture chimed like wind bells in the heat.
But the light rose only halfway before casting a moving image across the dome: at the eye of the mountaintop storm lay a huge blue heart, beating faintly.
Just as I thought... the Sacred Flame is only the key. Whatever truly froze the valley is up there.
story.json:/chapters/2/nodes/3/dialogue/: "The Long Snow began when the Frostheart slept. To call spring home, seek four kinds of human warmth—"
"The hope of a bonfire. The bond between neighbors. The courage to let go. The wish to pass on the light. When all four warmths unite, the Frostheart shall wake."
Let's go to Homewing Harbor first. The bridge and pier are open; it's time to bring the scattered families home.
story.json:/chapters/0/worldLore/1/text: A frostweaver shapes crystals with a wind lantern and warms the valley through the Everwarm Flame. Evan was the finest Frostweaver in Frostwhisper Valley, and the player's grandfather. After the catastrophe ten years ago, he vanished at the mountain peak.
story.json:/chapters/3/intro/0/1: Beyond the thawing river lies Frostwhisper Valley's old gateway to the world—Homewing Harbor.
story.json:/chapters/3/worldLore/0/text: Homewing Harbor is Frostwhisper Valley's only passage to the outside world. Every spring, those who moved south would ride the ferry home like returning geese. After the Long Snow began, the last ship to leave never came back.
story.json:/chapters/3/nodes/0/place: Homewing Harbor · The Lighthouse Dark for Ten Years
story.json:/chapters/3/nodes/1/place: Homewing Harbor · The Old Ferry Frozen in the Ice
story.json:/chapters/3/nodes/1/dialogue/: Woo-hoo! She's sounding again—the Warm Current can sail!
story.json:/chapters/3/nodes/1/lore/text: The Warm Current is Homewing Harbor's oldest ferry; before the disaster, she crossed between the two shores every day. When the old captain handed Barr the key, he said, 'Look after her. Come spring, I want to take her out one last time.'
story.json:/chapters/3/nodes/2/place: Homewing Harbor · The Deserted Pier Market
story.json:/chapters/3/nodes/3/place: Homewing Harbor · The Long Table for Those Coming Home
story.json:/chapters/3/nodes/3/dialogue/: ...There's no hiding from what comes next. Tomorrow, I'll take you into Frostwood and show you the truth of ten years ago.
story.json:/chapters/4/intro/0/1: Behind Homewing Harbor lies Frostwood, shrouded in mist all year. Deep among the trees stands an old waystation used by generations of Frostweavers.
story.json:/chapters/5/intro/0/1: Beyond Frostwood, the source of the Long Snow looms overhead—the summit of Frostheart Mountain, where the storm never rests.
story.json:/epilogue/3/1: Bobo became the busiest courier in Homewing Harbor. Not a single undelivered letter remained in his mailbag.
story.json:/epilogue/5/1: Barr restored the Warm Current and cast the music box's melody into the sanctuary's new bell. Whenever the wind blows, the whole valley can hear it.
story.json:/epilogue/8/1: Frost Story · Thank you, {{playerName}}, for merging spring back together, one piece at a time.
story.json:/epilogue/8/2/spoken: Frost Story. Thank you for merging spring back together, one piece at a time.
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/2/interacti: Rebuild the bridge so Bobo can deliver the first letter in ten years himself.
The ropes pull taut and the wind lantern flares to life. Clutching his mailbag, Bobo dashes across the path you laid.
story.json:/chapters/0/nodes/3/interacti: The lantern hangs from the rafters—and its story enters your Memory Journal. From now on, this hall bears your mark.
story.json:/chapters/1/nodes/0/interacti: Help Mier send the scent of the first bake down the street.
Golden light spills from the oven as the first Baked Flatbread puffs up. Along the street, someone follows the scent and opens a window.
story.json:/chapters/1/nodes/1/interacti: Choose the pattern that will hang on the tailor shop's sign. Your choice will be saved in your Memory Journal.
Elsa weaves your pattern into the scarf, then stitches the same mark onto the shop sign.
A road home for everyone who journeyed far.
The plaza's first flame, woven into every thread.
A star bright enough to find through falling snow.
story.json:/chapters/2/nodes/0/interacti: Bring Voices Back to the Sanctuary
Stop the wind, then set the Warm Stove. With every step, the empty hall feels more like home.
The doors fall quiet and firelight washes over the stone. For the first time in ten years, laughter echoes through the Sanctuary.
story.json:/chapters/2/nodes/1/interacti: Leave a Sky of Your Own in the Dome
Frost Crystals remember the constellations you arrange. Your design will remain in the Memory Journal.
The last Frost Crystal settles into place, and your constellation slowly kindles across the dome.
Points those far from home back toward Frostwhisper Valley.
Honors Gunnar, who watched over the village alone for ten years.
Lets every Flamekeeper's lantern meet beneath one sky.
